display_name: KANDA Desktop Help Exact Layout Blueprint
description: Exact reusable KANDA desktop-help HTML/CSS layout and browser-grade local-file rendering blueprint, loaded as a companion to the broader desktop help profile.
trigger_phrases: Show Project to AI help design
user_intent_examples: Create a KANDA help file using the exact established Show Project to AI layout.
when_to_load: When a KANDA help page must reproduce the established book-style layout and design model exactly.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for generic documentation or when the application has not adopted the KANDA desktop help profile.
do_not_regress: Keep this prompt auxiliary to KPR-12-010 rather than a competing help canon.
Inspect current Markdown, HTML, CSS, manifest, renderer, local-file loading path, and rendered output before authoring.
Use QWebEngineView with a real local-file URL as the primary renderer for the exact profile.
Do not use QTextEdit.setHtml or QTextBrowser.setHtml as the primary exact-layout renderer.
Preserve local assets, accessibility, responsive behavior, provenance, and truthful visual validation.
